references.text: This text describes the actual event when Nadab and Abihu, Aaron's two sons, died when they offered strange fire before the Lord. Leviticus 16:1 refers directly back to this event.
Mentions Nadab and Abihu as Aaron's sons in the genealogy, establishing their identity as priests.
Retells the death of Nadab and Abihu when they offered strange fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai.
Another reference to the death of Nadab and Abihu when they offered strange fire before the Lord.
Mentions Nadab and Abihu and their death, and that they had no sons.
Refers to the high priest entering the Most Holy Place once a year, an institution established after the death of Nadab and Abihu to prevent similar events.
